title: Chapter 35 Upgrading The Siheyuan
content:
Chapter 35 Upgrading The Siheyuan

[Arrow Tower: 200 Wood + 10 Stone + 1 Energy + 1000 Arrows, can add arrows, durability: 220/500, can be repaired. ]

Wang Shuo quickly consumed 100 Wood and 1 Energy to repair its durability to the full value.

Wang Shuo was relieved now, thinking that he still had the Energy Tower construction blueprint.

[Energy Tower: 500 Stone + 1 Soul Crystal + 100 Energy Crystal, energy is exhausted, can be replenished, durability: 1000/1000, consumes a certain amount of energy every 10 seconds, condenses a magic attack of 800 damage, and the attack range is 100 meters. ]

[Do you want to build an Energy Tower? ]

"Yes."

This attack is much higher than the Arrow Tower, but the firing speed is a bit slower, which can be regarded as both advantages and disadvantages.

With Arrow Towers and Energy Towers for long-range combat and Golden Armored Warriors for close combat, the safety factor of Wang Shuo's territory has been greatly improved.

At this time, the production of fire bricks was also completed. Wang Shuo went directly to the brick kiln and collected the blue tiles and fire bricks.

Suddenly Wang Shuo found that a group of yellow figures shot out directly from the vicinity of a brick kiln, passed by Wang Shuo, and disappeared in the distance. Wang Shuo directly opened the map.

Found a red light spot, constantly changing its position in his territory.

This was the first time Wang Shuo discovered that there was an invader since he fully controlled the territory.

Wang Shuo immediately became alert, quickly collected the blue tiles and fire bricks, and returned to the shelter.

Checked the gold coins, deducted the previous consumption of purchasing materials, and there were 451 more, enough to upgrade the courtyard.

Wang Shuo looked at the bronze key mold and found that it was not as popular as he imagined.

I don’t know if other players didn’t find it, or they prefer to buy low-priced bronze keys. After all, the unit price of each key is already very low, and there is no need to make it by themselves.

These key molds should be sold as much as possible, but there is no way if they can’t be sold.

All the materials are ready, and the courtyard can be upgraded.

Wang Shuo silently recited "Upgrade Siheyuan" in his heart.

[Siheyuan: Wood 4933/2000, Fire Brick 10,000/10,000, Green Tile 20,000/20,000, Stone 4945/2000, Energy Crystal 1725/20, Iron Ore 300/200, Gold Coin 451/100, Energy Converter 1/1. ]

[Are you sure you want to upgrade the residential building to Siheyuan? ]

"OK."

[Wood - 2000, Fire Brick - 10,000, Tile - 20,000, Stone - 2000, Energy Crystal - 20, Iron Ore - 200, Gold Coin - 100, Energy Converter - 1. ]

[Siheyuan is under construction, it will take 12 hours. ]

After doing all this, it was getting dark. Wang Shuo looked at the time. It was only a little after 4 pm, but it was already equivalent to 6 pm before.

There were still gusts of cold wind outside. Wang Shuo felt a bit of biting cold, so he returned to the house and added some firewood to the fire pit.

Wang Shuo took out the "Survivor's Handbook" and turned to the "Diary" page.

The eight words "The flood is coming, pouring into the ocean" were still on it.

"Humph."

Wang Shuo snorted coldly: "Next, let me expose your true face!"

He took out the purification scroll he exchanged from Hadro and used it on the "Diary".

[Do you want to purify the residual soul? ]

Before Wang Shuo could speak, the "Diary" finally began to panic, and the words on it disappeared in the blink of an eye.

New words formed, "Lord, spare my life!"

"I thought you were so tough that you would never beg for mercy even if you died!" Wang Shuo sneered with some contempt.

"Lord, I was wrong!"

"Tell me your origins."

The residual soul seemed to be recalling, and seemed to be lost in thought.

After becoming Shaoqing, he wrote in his diary: "My name is Chang Gui. I used to be a player. Round after round of games are like leeks in the field, cut one crop after another..."

Not long after, Wang Shuo figured out the ins and outs of the remnant soul Chang Gui.

According to him, he was also a player a long time ago. By chance, he realized a talent that could sense danger, so he could always detect danger in advance and find a way to resolve it.

But people often seem a little powerless in the face of the general trend. In the face of natural disasters that they cannot resist, what can they do even if they know it in advance!

Just like some clever people, they can't achieve great things in the end!

But he got a prop in advance that could transfer his soul to the "Survivor's Handbook", thus avoiding being sealed by Lord Zach and becoming a tool man.

This decision, in fact, turned out to be extremely stupid. Once the player bound to the "Survivor's Handbook" dies or becomes a tool man, the "Survivor's Handbook" will be recovered by Lord Zach.

In order to avoid the obliteration of his soul, he has to pay a huge price.

The souls that become tools still have a chance to wake up, but his soul is like a candle. If it is not replenished, it will only be consumed until it dissipates.

Wang Shuo also sighed a little. He had no choice when he came to this world.

But now is not the time to sympathize with others. Wang Shuo pondered for a while before slowly asking: "Give me a reason not to purify you."

Wang Shuo seemed to be giving him a reason to convince himself, and seemed to be trying to find out what value the remnant soul Chang Gui still had.

An old player can definitely bring him some unexpected benefits. After all, with the guidance of his seniors, he can avoid many detours.

But Chang Gui gave Wang Shuo an extremely dangerous feeling.

There is no guarantee that the boat will capsize in the sewer ditch, which puts Wang Shuo in a dilemma.

"I can give you an early warning, and I also know some future game processes." Chang Gui said with some urgency as if to grasp the last straw, not wanting to die.

Wang Shuo also took a fancy to this aspect of him. From the beginning, he was able to accurately predict treasure chests and crocodiles. Although the information was incomplete, it also brought him great convenience.

"It's best as you said. If I die, I will purify you before I die." Wang Shuo threatened.

"Don't dare, don't dare!" Chang Gui quickly wrote in his diary again.

Seeing that Wang Shuo no longer purified him, Chang Gui boldly said to Wang Shuo: "Lord, my soul power is already very weak. Can you give me a soul crystal first to supplement some soul power? ”

"Haha, you want to be rewarded before you have done anything. What a beautiful thought you have!" Wang Shuo has no intention of giving him any improvement in strength now. If the tiger hurts someone, he will shoot himself in the foot.

Immediately, Wang Shuo asked about the flood situation.

The two chatted for a long time, and learned from Chang Gui that the intensity of this flood test is different, and it often has a lot to do with the player's strength and the terrain where he is.

If the shelter is in a depression, it's basically a death sentence. A swampy terrain like Wang Shuo's is basically a death sentence.

Wang Shuo suddenly felt scared. Fortunately, he bought a water-proof sky cover, otherwise he would have been really cold.

At the same time, Wang Shuo also learned that Chang Gui had been consuming his soul power for a long time, and his perception of danger had dropped. In addition, for many things, he had to see the same scene or object before he could recall some relevant information.

This made Wang Shuo disappointed for a while. He originally thought he had met a know-it-all, but he didn't expect that he had big flaws. However, as long as he didn't get cheated, it was better than nothing.

Of course, these abilities can be improved by giving him soul crystals.

Chang Gui just tried to improve himself by changing the method, which was a conspiracy.

At this time, Wang Shuo was still in the observation period for Chang Gui, and he would never raise a tiger to cause trouble.

For this flood, we can only stop it with soldiers, and the water will cover it with soil.

Around 4 o'clock in the morning, a system emergency notification sounded.

[The Siheyuan is about to be upgraded. Players are asked to leave the shelter. 】

Wang Shuo hurriedly walked to the courtyard, but the system prompt was still there.

Wang Shuo had no choice but to retreat outside the courtyard wall.
